Question: The internal angles of quadrilateral \(ABCD\) form an arithmetic progression. Triangles \(ABD\) and \(DCB\) are similar with \(\angle DBA = \angle DCB\) and \(\angle ADB = \angle CBD.\) Moreover, the angles in each of these two triangles also form an arithmetic progression. In degrees, what is the largest possible sum of the two largest angles of \(ABCD?\)
